screening.threshold_rationale: Carried forward UNCHANGED from SCREEN-012 and SCREEN-013 so the promotion bar cannot drift run to run. The three BASELINE-011 seeds spanned 0.2732-0.3122 validation macro-F1 (SD 0.0196) with no factor changed between them, so a single-seed swing of 0.039 is attributable to seed alone. 0.04 is that observed spread rounded to two decimals and is registered BEFORE the run so the decision cannot be fitted to the result afterwards. This run is measured against SCREEN-012's single-seed 0.3537, not against BASELINE-011. Below it: inside seed noise, do not promote, and record the negative outcome. Above it: re-run as a three-seed REGISTERED_FULL_RUN_READY experiment before any number is quoted.
